entries.title: League-Wide Bye
entries.message:
Hello TMFL Fans! Due to travel conflicts, there will be a league-wide bye week beginning on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, lasting until Tuesday, November 17, 2026. Week 8 will begin on Thursday, November 19, 2026. 

Thank you,
TMFL Commissioner
